issue_request: FHIR-13298 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ConceptMap change request for STU3. It asked to replace the malformed Markdown link `[ConceptMapEquivalence]{concept-map-equivalence.html}` in OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate with normal parenthesized Markdown so Markdown Extra would not treat the braces as an attribute/class annotation.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 12858. In imported Git history this is commit 4584980dfd0384cbc1e48a651044b4422152e18a, `#13298 - fix markdown`, which fixed the same `{...}` Markdown-link pattern in several spreadsheet sources but does not show a ConceptMap operation hunk. Later ConceptMap operation source was reintroduced for R4B with a correct parenthesized ConceptMapEquivalence link, and the current source has since changed the output part to ConceptMapRelationship with a correct parenthesized link.
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Current source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml no longer contains the reported bad `{}` Markdown form, nor any ConceptMapEquivalence operation link needing this correction. FTS-safe Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The exact malformed link is absent from the current source tree, and the current ConceptMap $translate operation source uses `[ConceptMapRelationship](valueset-concept-map-relationship.html)` for the relevant output relationship documentation.
